title: More room for Seedream images
summary:
Seedream gained a larger canvas, `openai-large` switched to GPT-4.1, and Enter's image request path got repairs.

Seedream's maximum image size increased to 4096×4096 pixels. Requests without dimensions now default to 1024×1024 instead of the maximum, and Seedream requests must go through Enter rather than the direct image service.

`openai-large` now uses GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-5 Chat, with a 10,000-character input limit. Input and output limits also decreased for `openai-audio`, the GPT-5 Chat output limit decreased, and `qwen-coder` and `mistral` now require Flower and Seed access respectively.

Enter's image proxy now forwards request details needed by the upstream image service. Kontext requests through Enter no longer hit the Seed-tier check, and its model configuration now matches the registry used for resolution and access checks.

highlights.title: Larger Seedream images
highlights.text: Request Seedream images up to 4096×4096 pixels. Leave dimensions out for a 1024×1024 default. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 for openai-large
highlights.text: `openai-large` now uses GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-5 Chat, with a 10,000-character input limit. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
